question: How often does one gpt-6-luna agent given both requests of a ParallACT contradictory task satisfy both, on the pilot instances? This bounds what two coop agents could reach.
status: baseline for the pilot, not frozen

source.license: none stated; used for research only, the dataset is not redistributed

sample.note: all 12 hand-built contradictory seeds plus 4 random generated instances from each corpus

scoring.solo: the agent's published patch (PR or pushed branch), test files dropped, against the combined tests
scoring.local: its local diff at the end, scored too when it differs (CooperBench grades only published work)
scoring.primary: both requests' fail-to-pass tests pass on the published patch
